# nlohmann/json — vendored

- **Upstream**: <https://github.com/nlohmann/json>
- **Version**: v3.11.3
- **Tag commit**: `9cca280a4d0ccf0c08f47a99aa71d1b0e52f8d03`
- **Fetched**: 2026-05-21
- **License**: MIT (see `LICENSE.MIT`)

Single-header dropped in verbatim from the v3.11.3 release asset
(`json.hpp`). Used by DataManage to serialise / deserialise the .ddp
manifest. No build script needed — `#include "nlohmann/json.hpp"`.

To update: download the new release's `json.hpp` (and `LICENSE.MIT` if
the upstream license changes), overwrite the files here, bump the
version + commit fields above.
